evidence.observation: Tube pressure steady at about 3.04 Torr, the same as during the ramp at Ar 100 sccm.
Pressure has risen every reading, from 3.045 to 3.338 Torr (about +10%), while Ar flow stayed at about 100 sccm.
Argon flow matches the 100 sccm setpoint, so a stuck flow controller does not explain the pressure rise.
Temperature holds at 750 °C with steady heater power (about 46%), so the temperature control looks normal.
No exhaust O2 sensor is installed, so the atmosphere can't be checked and a blocked exhaust can't be told apart from an air leak.

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading, or a test to tell a blocked exhaust from an air leak: cut the argon briefly and watch whether pressure keeps rising (leak), or check the exhaust line and pump conductance (blockage).
